notes: Just inside the single heavy frame rule on left, top and right; the bottom edge sits just above the legend strip's top rule (README rule 3: the ruled-off legend and title strip is outside; the planning-code note, north arrow and scale bar printed in it are outside with it, so there is no remove polygon). Each side's inner edge was measured column by column, smoothed with a robust local-linear fit, and the outline set ~2.5 px inside it (README rule 1; the 1-bit rules are stair-stepped and have 1 px nubs, so 2.5 px keeps them outside), points every ~50-250 px; corners where the fitted sides meet. What little ink is left under the outline is map lines that run into the legend rule (kind b) and single-px nubs on the rules. The page is turned slightly (left and right rules drift ~25 px right top to bottom). No holes (rule 4, floating blocks are map): the pier-head note in the bottom-right corner just above the legend strip ('ZONING DISTRICTS ALONG THE BAY EXTEND TO THE PIER HEAD LINE ... PLANNING CODE SECTION 105(e).') has no ruled box of its own, so it is inside (it sits right on the legend rule; the outline passes ~2 px under its lowest letters). No SECTION badge. 'J.E. CODY', the BULKHEAD LINE / PIERHEAD LINE lettering, INDIA BASIN, SOUTH BASIN and SAN FRANCISCO BAY are map.
